name: Starkholmes Recreation Ground
description: Derbyshire Dales District Council lists Starkholmes Recreation Ground among its smaller parks and gardens. OpenStreetMap shows a playground here, but we haven't yet found an official source that confirms the play equipment.

sources.label: Derbyshire Dales District Council: our smaller parks and gardens

notConfirmed: Exact position (taken from OpenStreetMap), age ranges, play equipment, opening hours, toilets and parking. The pin is a playground mapped on OpenStreetMap (© OpenStreetMap contributors) at the site. The council lists this site as a recreation ground, so the play area itself is unverified.
